# Charlotta

## Overview

- **Age:** Fourteen years old  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c21 P44](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0044)</sub>
- **Origin:** Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v2 c23 P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** Handmaiden and housekeeper for Miss Lavendar Lewis at Echo Lodge  <sub>[v2 c21 P44](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0044), [v2 c21 P58](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0058)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Charlotta the Fourth  <sub>[v2 c21 P44](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0044)</sub>; Leonora  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>

## Appearance

Charlotta the Fourth is a small, freckled fourteen-year-old girl with a wide mouth, a snub nose, and a cheerful expression. She has two long braids of fair hair that she adorns with enormous blue ribbon bows. She often wears a starched white dress and strives to imitate Anne Shirley's graceful ways.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P39](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0039), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c27 P39](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0039), [v2 c30 P27](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0027), [v2 c30 P40](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0040)_

## Personality

Charlotta is a cheerful, affectionate, and fiercely loyal handmaiden who adores her mistress, Miss Lavendar. She is hard-working, energetic, and eager to please, often bustling around in an excited manner. Although literal-minded and inclined to worry about practical mishaps, she enjoys Anne's romantic stories and accepts her mistress's imaginative tendencies without judgment.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P44](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0044), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c27 P39](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0039), [v2 c28 P55](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0055), [v2 c28 P67](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0067), [v2 c30 P12](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0012)_

## Traits

- Cheerfully loyal and affectionate  <sub>[v2 c21 P44](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0044), [v2 c29 P31](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0031)</sub>
- Energetic and hard-working  <sub>[v2 c28 P12](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0012), [v2 c29 P3](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0003)</sub>
- Literal-minded  <sub>[v2 c28 P50](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0050), [v2 c28 P53](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0053)</sub>
- Easily excited and anxious about household mishaps  <sub>[v2 c28 P12](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0012), [v2 c30 P19](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0019)</sub>

## Abilities

- Housekeeping and cooking assistance  <sub>[v2 c21 P58](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0058), [v2 c28 P12](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0012)</sub>

## Goals

- To serve and care for Miss Lavendar Lewis faithfully  <sub>[v2 c27 P44](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0044), [v2 c28 P55](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0055)</sub>
- To learn how to move, speak, and act like Anne Shirley  <sub>[v2 c27 P39](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0039), [v2 c27 P50](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0050)</sub>
- To go to Boston to live with Miss Lavendar and Stephen Irving  <sub>[v2 c29 P3](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0003)</sub>

## History

Leonora Bowman, nicknamed 'Charlotta the Fourth' by Miss Lavendar Lewis, entered service at Echo Lodge to assist with housekeeping. She developed a deep affection for Miss Lavendar and befriended Anne Shirley and Diana Barry upon their visits. She assisted in entertaining guests, including Paul Irving and Stephen Irving. When Stephen Irving returned to marry Miss Lavendar, Charlotta enthusiastically helped prepare Echo Lodge for the wedding. At the ceremony, she threw an old shoe for luck, accidentally striking the minister, Mr. Allan. Following the wedding, she helped pack up Echo Lodge and arranged to move to Boston with Mr. and Mrs. Irving.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P44](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0044), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c23 P27](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0027), [v2 c28 P12](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0012), [v2 c28 P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048), [v2 c29 P3](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0003), [v2 c30 P32](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0032), [v2 c30 P33](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0033)_

## Background by volume

- Her real name is Leonora, but she is called Charlotta the Fourth because she is the fourth girl in her family to serve Miss Lavendar, following her sisters Charlotta, Julietta, and Evelina  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- She is the youngest of the Bowman sisters from Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c23 P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010)</sub>
- Hired at thirteen to live and work at Echo Lodge for board and clothes  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>

## Quotes

> I’m glad for Miss Lavendar’s sake and for my own too.  <sub>[v2 c27 P50](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0050)</sub>

> I don’t care what people think about me if they don’t let me see it.  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
